about_the_game:
Season 9 Pro Pass & Hall of Fame Pass will expire at 7:59AM PT, December 31st, 2025. Any purchase of the Season 9 Pro Pass or Hall of Fame Pass is non-refundable.

The NBA 2K24 Pro Pass: Season 9 takes your MyCAREER and MyTEAM experience to the next level. The Pro Pass unlocks access to 40 levels of earnable premium rewards, including up to 45,000 VC as you progress through the Season on your way to level 40! Get the Season 9 Pro Pass & automatically receive a Geometric Patterned Oversized Hoodie, Animating Electric Circuit Racesuit, G.O.A.T. Kevin Durant MyTEAM Card, & a Season 9 Pro Pass Pack.

*NBA 2K24 Pro Pass requires base game, internet connection and NBA 2K Account.
